title: 12 பாவகங்களில் அந்தரங்க ரகசியங்கள் (12 Houses Secrets)
description: Lagna & 7th: Head/Face and spouse's private parts; 2nd & 8th: Family/wealth and hidden matters/excretory; 3rd & 9th: Valor/father; 4th: Mother/chest/nourishment; 5th: Progeny/ancestral karma; 6th: Disease/debt/service; 10th: Karma/profession; 11th: In-laws/gains; 12th: Bed pleasures/moksha.

title: முதியோர் இல்லத்தில் தள்ளப்படும் நிலை (Old Age Home Indication)
description: 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th lords afflicted in Dusthanas (6, 8, 12), in Parivarthanai with malefics, or oppressed by malefic planets leads to spending old age in senior care homes.
